link.7652579600f1.source:
Discovery is a trust boundary. Treat a tools/list response as untrusted input. Before connecting the server:
  • verify its identity,
  • show the requested capabilities to the user,
  • grant the smallest useful scope,
  • and bind each credential to that server's audience.
For remote connection and OAuth discovery, reject private and link-local destinations and validate every redirect. The MCP security guidance assigns consent, token handling, and server-side request forgery (SSRF) controls to the client.
link.7652579600f1.value:
发现过程也是信任边界。请将 tools/list 响应视为不可信输入。连接服务器之前：
  • 验证其身份，
  • 向用户显示所请求的能力，
  • 授予满足使用需求的最小权限范围，
  • 并将每项凭据绑定到该服务器对应的受众。
对于远程连接和 OAuth 发现，请拒绝私有地址和链路本地地址，并验证每一次重定向。 MCP 安全指南要求客户端负责用户同意、token 处理以及服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）控制。

A sprawling flat tool list tends to perform worse than a small set of tools backed by sub-agents, because each loop only sees the tools relevant to its level.

rich.3ca94d8b3cef.source: The server enforces the schema. Before structured function calling, applications often parsed custom XML or hand-written JSON from model text. A paraphrase could break that parser. The tools field carries the contract separately, so the serving engine can constrain arguments to the schema and return a consistent tool_calls field. Your dispatch code can then count on tc.function.name and tc.function.arguments being present and parseable.
rich.3ca94d8b3cef.value: 服务器负责执行模式约束。在结构化函数调用出现之前，应用通常需要从模型文本中解析自定义 XML 或手写的 JSON。模型只要换一种表述，就可能导致解析器失效。tools 字段将约定单独传递，因此推理服务引擎可以约束参数，使其符合模式，并返回格式一致的 tool_calls 字段。这样，分派代码便可以确信 tc.function.name 和 tc.function.arguments 始终存在且可解析。

rich.53f3a05d290a.source: The same loop runs here as a flat mountRunCell script, with one change: the executor. The earlier search returned a short blurb for each of several matches. This backend returns the whole article for the single best match, fetched from the term's cached glossary page. The schema and the loop do not move; only the source behind glossary_search got richer.
rich.53f3a05d290a.value: 此处以扁平的 mountRunCell 脚本运行相同循环，只有一处变化：执行器。之前的搜索会为多个匹配项分别返回一段简短说明。此后端则会从该术语的缓存术语表页面中，获取最佳匹配项的完整文章。模式和循环均未改变；只是 glossary_search 背后的数据源变得更加丰富。

rich.5e60c782fb3e.source: Model Context Protocol (MCP) gives tool serving a standard shape. The agent retrieves a server's catalog with tools/list and invokes a selected entry with tools/call. Those tools live in a separate process that the agent connects to and queries when it starts up. Because the protocol is the same everywhere, the agent can connect to additional servers without learning a new interface for each one. Use MCP when tool discovery and transport need a shared protocol. Use a local function, a repo skill, or a direct API call when the harness already knows where the capability lives and how to invoke it.
rich.5e60c782fb3e.value: Model Context Protocol (MCP) 为工具服务提供了标准形式。智能体通过 tools/list 获取服务器的工具目录，并通过 tools/call 调用所选条目。这些工具运行在独立进程中，智能体启动时会连接该进程并进行查询。由于各处采用相同协议，智能体无需为每台服务器学习新的接口，即可连接更多服务器。当工具发现和传输需要共享协议时，请使用 MCP。如果执行框架已经知道能力的位置和调用方式，则使用本地函数、仓库技能或直接的 API 调用。

rich.6409a1729518.source: The page follows that contract from local functions to a search backend and a sub-agent. A sub-agent as a tool places one focused agent behind a single schema so the outer workflow can route work without exposing every internal capability. Model Context Protocol (MCP) gives a client a standard way to discover and call tools served by another process. Use it at a capability boundary, after validating the server, identity, and scope. Both patterns keep the main loop's tool list small and motivate Module 2's scoped workflows.
rich.6409a1729518.value: 本页沿用这一约定，从本地函数逐步扩展到搜索后端和子智能体。将子智能体用作工具，就是将一个专注于特定任务的智能体封装在单一模式之后，使外层工作流可以分派任务，而不暴露其全部内部能力。Model Context Protocol (MCP) 为客户端提供了一套标准方法，用于发现并调用由其它进程提供的工具。请在能力边界处使用它，并先验证服务器、身份和权限范围。这两种模式都能精简主循环的工具列表，并为模块 2 中限定范围的工作流奠定基础。

rich.6e4cb8b55f4e.source: Agents rarely have a single tool. With more than one, the model decides which to call based on the description field.
rich.6e4cb8b55f4e.value: 智能体很少只有一个工具。当存在多个工具时，模型会根据 description 字段决定调用哪一个。

rich.b765d42d1fb8.source: A tool name should describe a capability. A tool called nvidia_glossary_api is brittle: changing the backend forces you to update every prompt that references the name. A tool called glossary_search describes what the caller needs. Ranked search, exact lookup, or a richer index can sit behind that contract without changing the agent prompt.
rich.b765d42d1fb8.value: 工具名称应描述一种能力。名为 nvidia_glossary_api 的工具很脆弱：一旦更换后端，您就必须更新所有引用该名称的提示词。名为 glossary_search 的工具描述的是调用方所需的能力。排序搜索、精确查询或更丰富的索引都可以置于该约定之后，无需更改智能体提示词。

rich.ccbfb037b2af.source: The tool_choice parameter can be set to "required" or to a specific tool name. When would forcing a tool call be the right move, and what risk does it create?
rich.ccbfb037b2af.value: tool_choice 参数可设置为 "required" 或特定工具名称。在哪些情况下应该强制执行工具调用？这样做会带来什么风险？

rich.d17e905c8785.source: The model only sees the contract. It asks for glossary_search with a natural query and reads whatever comes back, unaware which backend answered. You can start with a blurb index and later swap in full articles or a live search without touching the loop. Accuracy may drift when a backend resolves a match differently, but the contract holds.
rich.d17e905c8785.value: 模型只能看到约定。它使用自然语言查询请求 glossary_search，并读取返回的内容，却不知道是哪个后端作出的响应。可以先使用简短说明索引，之后再替换为完整文章或实时搜索，无需修改循环。如果不同后端采用不同方式确定匹配项，准确性可能会发生变化，但约定仍然有效。
